notes: Matched on passage and rule: 56 pairs (45 in the university guidance, 6 in MS-AAI, 5 in MS-ADS). Main disagreements: (1) phase, where coder A used 'general' for data-entry and tool-use rules that coder B placed in 'during-work'; resolved to during-work for rules applied at the time of use and general for principles, scope and commitments. (2) modality for bare imperatives and commitments (must vs should vs informs), resolved from the passage's own wording. (3) policy_type splits: P32 vs P41 for learning-protection lines, P76 vs P59 and P48 for staff use, P115 vs P62/P80/P92 for referrals, P61 vs P07 for the plug-in scope sentence; resolved by re-reading the passage against the type definition. (4) unit_stance on disclosure and avoid-misuse lines (neutral vs permit, prohibit vs restrict). Only-A units (6 in the university guidance, 1 in MS-ADS) were all kept. Only-B units: 5 kept in the university guidance (separate Gemini 'may be used' rule, Research-requirements sentence, Copley referral in the copyright section, 'cannot anticipate every situation', OGC referral); 1 list-label unit and 10 generic integrity or duplicate-split units were dropped. Stances agreed in all 3 documents. Agreement on unit_stance is also reported.
